tools.purpose: Forge an array-of-bytes signature that survives several builds: anchor on the baseline, align the same site in every other build, turn differing bytes into wildcards, and refuse to emit a pattern that is not unique per build.
tools.expect: signature string with wildcard count, per-build file offset and RVA drift, widening attempts, and a unique-in-every-build verdict

notes: Read-only and fail-closed: an ambiguous or non-unique signature exits non-zero instead of printing a pattern that would hit the wrong site. Wildcards over opcode bytes mean the pattern describes two different instructions.
